task_activity_actor.name: task_activity_actor
task_activity_actor.value: ("task_activity"."actor_type" = 'member' and "task_activity"."member_id" is not null and "task_activity"."admin_id" is null) or ("task_activity"."actor_type" = 'admin' and "task_activity"."admin_id" is not null and "task_activity"."member_id" is null)

task_assignees_actor.name: task_assignees_actor
task_assignees_actor.value: ("task_assignees"."updated_by_member_id" is null or "task_assignees"."updated_by_admin_id" is null) and ("task_assignees"."assigned_by_member_id" is null or "task_assignees"."assigned_by_admin_id" is null)

task_note_revisions_editor_actor.name: task_note_revisions_editor_actor
task_note_revisions_editor_actor.value: ("task_note_revisions"."editor_type" = 'member' and "task_note_revisions"."editor_member_id" is not null and "task_note_revisions"."editor_admin_id" is null) or ("task_note_revisions"."editor_type" = 'admin' and "task_note_revisions"."editor_admin_id" is not null and "task_note_revisions"."editor_member_id" is null)

tasks_created_by_actor.name: tasks_created_by_actor
tasks_created_by_actor.value: ("tasks"."created_by_member_id" is not null) <> ("tasks"."created_by_admin_id" is not null)

tasks_updated_by_actor.name: tasks_updated_by_actor
tasks_updated_by_actor.value: ("tasks"."updated_by_member_id" is not null) <> ("tasks"."updated_by_admin_id" is not null)

tasks_completion_consistent.name: tasks_completion_consistent
tasks_completion_consistent.value: ("tasks"."status" = 'completed') = ("tasks"."completed_at" is not null) and ("tasks"."completed_at" is null) = ("tasks"."completed_by_member_id" is null and "tasks"."completed_by_admin_id" is null) and ("tasks"."completed_by_member_id" is null or "tasks"."completed_by_admin_id" is null)

tasks_note_consistent.name: tasks_note_consistent
tasks_note_consistent.value: ("tasks"."progress_note_version" = 0) = ("tasks"."note_updated_at" is null) and ("tasks"."progress_note" is null or "tasks"."progress_note_version" > 0) and ("tasks"."note_updated_by_member_id" is null or "tasks"."note_updated_by_admin_id" is null)
